contracts.prompt_snippet: MACHINE CONTRACT (required): in your wrap-up, alongside the prose, emit ONE fenced ```phase-output-json``` block containing a single JSON object of the form {"phase": "doc_gap_fill", "doc_sections": {"<slot key>": "<the drafted markdown for that blueprint slot>"}}. Key each entry by the blueprint slot it fills. Draft ONLY from the project's published artifacts and prior-phase decisions — never fabricate a fact the artifacts don't support; where the evidence for a slot is genuinely absent, OMIT that slot from doc_sections and name the gap in your prose instead. The documentation renderer ingests these keyed sections verbatim, so each value must be finished, self-contained markdown.
